items.title: SHEPHERD
items.quote: Hashem is my Shepherd I will not lack.
items.text: Think of Hashem as your shepherd Who provides for all your needs.

items.title: TRANQUILITY
items.quote: He leads me beside tranquil waters.
items.text: Be grateful that you are leading a relatively tranquil life.

items.title: GUIDANCE
items.quote: He leads me on righteous pathways.
items.text: Be grateful that Hashem has given you the Torah and talmidei chachamim to interpret it.

items.w: לא אירא רע כי אתה עמדי
items.title: CONTINUING PRESENCE
items.quote: I will not fear evil for You are with me.
items.text: Remember that Hashem is always with you.

items.title: WORLDLY SUCCESS
items.quote: You set out a table before me.
items.text: Give thanks to Hashem for your worldly success.

items.title: YOUR MISSION
items.quote: You have anointed my head with oil; my cup is full.
items.text: Give thanks to Hashem for giving you a mission in life and giving you the means to fulfill it.

items.w: אך טוב וחסד ירדפוני כל ימי חיי
items.title: MIDDOS
items.quote: But may goodness and kindness pursue me all the days of my life.
items.text: Ask Hashem to help you perfect your middos so that virtuous behavior will come naturally to you.

items.title: DWELLING
items.quote: and let me dwell in the House of Hashem, for the length of [my] days.
items.text: Ask Hashem for the privilege of learning Torah and doing His will.
